name: gizza-ai/audio-volume-adjust
summary: Boost or cut audio volume by dB or a factor

tool.description: Increase or decrease an audio file's volume. Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). amount is in decibels by default (6 boosts, -6 cuts; range ±60) or a linear factor with unit=factor (2 doubles, 0.5 halves; range (0,16]). A peak limiter (on by default) caps output at 0 dBFS so boosts don't clip. Output is re-encoded to mp3 (192 kbps), wav, ogg, flac or m4a.

amount.description: How much to change the volume: with unit=db, decibels (6 boosts, -6 cuts, 0 not allowed); with unit=factor, a multiplier in (0, 16] (2 doubles, 0.5 halves).

format.description: Output audio format. Default mp3 (192 kbps).

limiter.description: Cap peaks at 0 dBFS (alimiter) so boosts don't clip. Default on; disable for exact linear gain.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

unit.description: How amount is interpreted: decibels (default) or a linear factor.

url.description: Audio URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
